blind_target.evidence_quote: In this study we replicate the extended BXS [19] cross-nationally to measure differences in the ways consumers experience the eco-friendliness of global smartphone brands in a cross-national context. The survey items were selected from the previously developed and extended BXS [18,19,107]. We assess the four items measuring eco-friendliness as well as the other four brand experience dimensions from the BXS by conducting structural equation modeling (SEM) and confirmatory factor analysis (CFA) following the same steps that Brakus et al. [18] undertook.
blind_target.outcome_quote: The findings of our study indicate that the eco-friendliness dimension can be generalized in two countries with very different demographics and economic situations.
